description: This file contains the implementation of DhtGrainLocator class responsible for locating grains using an in-memory distributed directory in Orleans. It provides methods for lookup, registration, and unregistration of grains, along with internal batching logic for deregistration operations.

classes.name: DhtGrainLocator
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainLocator that uses in-memory distributed directory for grain location services.

classes.name: BatchedDeregistrationWorker
classes.description: Internal class that manages batching of deregistration requests to optimize unregistration calls, processing them in batches asynchronously.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up the address of a grain given its GrainId.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address with the directory, with support for updating previous registration.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a grain address based on a specified cause, utilizing batching through internal worker classes.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates the cache entry for a specific grain id with a new silo address.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates the cache entry for a specific grain id or grain address.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a cached grain address for a given grain id.
